content.content: 1. Necessity: the delegation rule needs the grammar for invocation shape — without a verb notion, trailing-arg pass-through is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element contradicts any prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
